title: Absolute phishing-probability movement |P0 − Pi|
research_question: How large is paired movement relative to C0 within each true class?
y_axis: Class-specific mean movement (95% frame bootstrap interval)
main_observation: No primary complete frames; estimates are unavailable. Legitimate and phishing observations are labelled separately; a class with N=0 has no estimate. Positive signed movement means lower phishing probability than C0. Intervals resample frames with seed 42.
allowed_interpretation: This describes paired score sensitivity within each class for retained frames.
forbidden_interpretation: Probability movement alone does not establish evasion, correctness, or semantic equivalence.
